contract.target_initial_state: all target patches begin with zero adults and zero seed-bank cohorts
contract.hidden_target_gate: every target patch_id and exact EnvironmentSample checksum must be absent from all E2.2 bake geography/ecology evidence
contract.solver_reuse: accepted P2.6 plant_long_horizon_biogeography_v1.gd is called directly; dispersal, establishment, resource competition, turnover and succession remain inherited mechanics
contract.hard_freeze: evolution/mutation kernels, adaptive genome mutation, lineage creation, target-aware rebake, biome lookup and target species tables are absent from the API and executable source
contract.valid_no_colonization: a fully executed target that remains unreachable is VALID_NO_COLONIZATION rather than an execution error
contract.integrity: validate_result independently reruns deterministic transfer from the exact frozen bake and target and requires exact result equality
contract.source_mutation: frozen bake/catalog and target inputs are duplicated or read-only and must remain unchanged
contract.rng: no global RNG may be consumed by the transfer wrapper or accepted deterministic mechanics
